questions.question: What is the Kebbi Progressive Youth Network (KPN)?

answer.html: The Kebbi Progressive Youth Network (KPN) is a civic, media, advocacy, youth development, and community engagement organization. Our vision is to build a digitally empowered generation of young people leading positive change for a better, united, and progressive Kebbi State.

answer.html: Our motto is:"One Voice, One Change."

questions.question: How does KPN fund its activities?

answer.html: KPN raises funds through voluntary donations from members, civic-minded citizens, crowdfunding campaigns, support from NGOs and development partners, and other lawful grants. Financial transparency is heavily prioritized, and all funds are strictly managed by our finance directors.

questions.question: How does KPN gather community reports?

answer.html: Ward and LGA teams observe and identify community needs, abandoned projects, positive developments, and opportunities. Reports are collected with evidence (summaries, photos, videos) and submitted upward.
answer.text: Ward and LGA teams observe and identify community needs, abandoned projects, positive developments, and opportunities. Reports are collected with evidence (summaries, photos, videos) and submitted upward.

answer.html: Reports undergo verification at the LGA level, are escalated by Senatorial teams, and undergo a final editorial review and fact-checking by the State Media & Communications Team before publication.

questions.question: How is information classified before publication?

answer.html: To ensure public trust, KPN classifies information based on its verification level:
answer.text: To ensure public trust, KPN classifies information based on its verification level:

answer.html:
•
  • KPN VERIFIED: Checked and supported by reliable evidence.
answer.text: KPN VERIFIED: Checked and supported by reliable evidence.

answer.html:
•
  • KPN CONFIRMED: Confirmed by multiple reliable sources.
answer.text: KPN CONFIRMED: Confirmed by multiple reliable sources.

answer.html:
•
  • KPN DEVELOPING: Still being checked, updates pending.
answer.text: KPN DEVELOPING: Still being checked, updates pending.

answer.html:
•
  • KPN COMMUNITY ALERT: Urgent matters affecting public safety or welfare.
answer.text: KPN COMMUNITY ALERT: Urgent matters affecting public safety or welfare.

answer.html:
•
  • KPN OPPORTUNITY: Legitimate jobs, scholarships, or training programs.
